title: CAS-06751 — Shortland Street — RTÉ Radio 1
text:
Programme: Shortland Street
Broadcast / VOD service: RTÉ Radio 1
Date broadcast or accessed: 16.02.2026
Statute and/or regulatory code: Code of Programme Standards: Obligations 12.1 (a), (c), (e) & (f), 12.2, 12.3, 12.5 & 13.1(iii)
Short description: The complaint is about the inclusion of a middle finger gesture which the complainant alleges caused harm and offence
Outcome: Dismissed
Commission Decision: Dismiss the complaint pursuant to section 48(4)(a) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended.
Commission Decision Date: 23.04.2026
